accounting_methodology_disclosure.practical_tradeoff_summary: Full uncapped isolated execution (24 PUBs, 7.125 credits per policy) achieves 18/24 accepted for P1_SABRE_Isolated (2.5263 acc/credit) and 17/24 for P2_TKET_Isolated (2.3860 acc/credit). Under 4-Way spatial packing (6 PUBs, 1.50 credits per policy), P6_Prometheus_Full_Manager delivers 16/24 accepted (10.6667 acc/credit), beating all other packed policies (P3=14/24, P4=13/24, P5=15/24) and outperforming the reconstructed 8-PUB (1.875-credit) isolated cutoff (7/24 = 3.7333 acc/credit). Thus on IQM Emerald, P6 demonstrates a 4.0x PUB reduction and 4.22x higher accepted-workloads-per-credit vs. uncapped SABRE isolated (10.67 vs 2.53 acc/cr) at the trade-off of 2 fewer total accepted workloads (16/24 vs 18/24) than uncapped isolated execution.
